notes.subject: every circumcised one in foreskin
notes.rationale: כָּל מוּל בְּעָרְלָה: read literally, 'every circumcised in uncircumcision' — those circumcised in flesh yet uncircumcised in heart (compare v. 25, 'all the nations are uncircumcised, and all the house of Israel uncircumcised of heart'); some repoint to מוּל as preposition 'upon every front of the foreskin'.

notes.subject: ⟨one⟩
notes.rationale: מוּל is the participle/noun 'circumcised'; English supplies the head noun.

notes.subject: the days that are coming
notes.rationale: an announced but undisclosed future visitation, picked up by the list of nations in v. 25.

translation: Behold, days are coming — the oracle of YHWH — and I will punish every circumcised ⟨one⟩ in foreskin.
